name: Sorriso, Brazil
note: Soybean then second-crop maize, then a long bare dry season.

name: Bogura, Bangladesh
note: Monsoon rice, then a dry-season crop on stored water and some irrigation.

name: Machakos, Kenya
place: Semi-arid eastern Kenya, two short rainy seasons
note: Smallholder maize in both rainy seasons, where the rains often fail.

name: Ames, Iowa, USA
note: Maize one year and soybean the next, with bare soil through winter.

name: Maradi, Niger
note: Rainfed millet in one short, risky rainy season.

name: Ludhiana, India
note: Irrigated rice then wheat, on groundwater that is falling.

name: Lilongwe, Malawi
note: Maize every year, in a region hit hard by El Nino droughts.
